findings.one_line: The induction and recurrence require every introduceEdge({u,v}) node to have {u,v} subseteq B_t (so its endpoints are present); the stated nice-node assumption only gives B_t=B_s, so under the declared assumptions an edge may be designated before either endpoint is in the state. State this endpoint-in-bag condition (and use it in the recurrence) to discharge the locality claims at introduce and forget nodes.
